title: A Quasicontinuum Method with Optimized Local Maximum-Entropy Interpolation and Heaviside Enrichment for Heterogeneous Lattices
summary: Lattice systems are effective for modeling heterogeneous materials, but their computational cost is often prohibitive. The QuasiContinuum (QC) method reduces this cost by interpolating the lattice response over a coarse finite-element mesh, yet material interfaces in heterogeneous systems still require fine discretizations. Enrichment strategies from the eXtended Finite Element Method (XFEM) address this by representing interfaces on nonconforming meshes.
